title: Binary content that is a number

source.note: composed: the third shape a `binary` content can wrongly take, after an object (case 34) and an array (case 37). Table 1 makes `binary` bytes, and §6.4 makes the JSON spelling base64.

notes: A number is not a lenient spelling of bytes the way unpadded base64 is a lenient spelling of base64 (case 06): there is no rule under which it decodes to a payload, so it is an error rather than a warning. A peer that means to send a reading rather than a recording wants `location`, `structured` or `generic`.
